candidate_source_snapshot.formula: sha256(concat(sorted_by_raw_utf8(repo_relative_path) of utf8(path) || TAB || ascii(sha256(raw_file_bytes)) || TAB || ascii(decimal_size_bytes) || LF))

staging_exception_exit.finding: Both standalone and retained transaction staging install an exception verifier only after the complete directory identity baseline exists. Every later content, bundle, safe-entry or final-set exception re-proves all named directory edges before preserving the original exception. Persistent drift therefore overrides a conflict with WORK_PATH_UNSAFE, while unchanged different-byte conflicts remain STAGING_CONFLICT.
staging_exception_exit.resource_cleanup: Comparison descriptors are closed by each verifier and retained descriptors remain closed in the existing finally blocks.

captured_snapshot_exit.finding: The inventory-independent directory verifier checks retained descriptors and reopens vault/.raw/captured. Initial scan and verification rescan each have pre-check plus success/exception post-checks. OSError from a missing or replaced named vault root is sanitized as CAPTURE_SNAPSHOT_INVALID rather than escaping FileNotFoundError.
captured_snapshot_exit.unchanged_limit_behavior: An unchanged 1025-entry captured directory remains UPSTREAM_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

r4_input_phase_fix.finding: Request parsing/schema/correlation/canonical validation still precedes plan access; request/prepared drift and post-bind plan drift retain the frozen phase-aware override behavior.

public_surface.finding: No public API, schema, contract, authority bytes, normal conflict/limit code, publication ordering or create/reuse behavior changed.
